name: @composable-os/pack-bookings
description: Bookings: a gym's or studio's timetable (weekly series that make dated classes in local time), rooms, coaches, closures, and the bookings members make and cancel within the class type's rules, spending a membership's or pass's use (stage 31a). Its class types are its own (stage 78). Installed in every deployment of a product that lists it. Bundled as source into cos-runner.

composableOs.label: Bookings
composableOs.description: A timetable of classes made from weekly series, booked and cancelled by members on the web and in the app within the gym's rules.
